cohort: Mothers of twins and singletons in eight Eastern and Southern African countries: Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, and Zimbabwe.
finding: Mothers of twins in Eastern and Southern Africa receive insufficient care, resulting in very high neonatal mortality rates.
mod_finding: The percentage of twin deliveries by cesarean section varied from 9% in Mozambique to 36% in Rwanda.
country: Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, and Zimbabwe
